meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将实现任务自动拆分为可合并的PR并完成全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将开发任务拆成多个独立PR并自动走完提交流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate full PR lifecycle from task decomposition to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to split development tasks into independent PRs and automate the submission process

howto.what: 把任务拆成最小可独立合并的PR,每个PR在独立git worktree中实现;用ulw-loop完成开发并做有证据的人工QA,写出英文PR,跑CI和Cubic验证,失败就回到该PR的worktree修复再QA,最后默认自动合并并清理worktree。
howto.when: 当你说“create a PR”“implement and PR”“work on this and make a PR”“implement issue”“land this as a PR”“split into atomic PRs”等词,或上下文暗示需要以PR交付时触发。

say.text: 把这个问题拆成原子PR,并行实现并提交。
say.note: 会开始拆分任务、建立worktree并并行开发。

say.text: 实现这个 issue 并做成PR,跑完CI和Cubic。
say.note: 会走完整生命周期,直到两个门禁通过后合并。

say.text: 帮我审查这个PR的QA证据是否充分。
say.note: 会按PR模板检查证据文件和风险说明。

howto.what_en: Splits a task into the smallest independently mergeable PRs, implements each in its own git worktree via the ulw-loop skill with evidence-bound manual QA, writes an English PR, runs a CI + Cubic verification loop, sends failures back to fix-and-re-QA, then auto-merges and cleans up worktrees.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs' etc., or when context implies PR delivery.

say_en.text: Split this issue into atomic PRs and implement them in parallel.
say_en.note: It decomposes, sets up worktrees, and develops concurrently.

say_en.text: Implement this issue and make a PR, running CI and Cubic.
say_en.note: It runs the full lifecycle and merges once gates pass.

say_en.text: Review whether the QA evidence in this PR is sufficient.
say_en.note: It checks evidence files and risk statements against the PR template.
